scientific_question: Which high-speed airflow region is strongest in the office, and where is it located? For this analysis, define high-speed airflow as velocity magnitude above 0.20 in the stored velocity scale, treat locations connected through shared grid faces as one contiguous region, use peak speed as the measure of strength, and represent the strongest region by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations. Identify the strongest region and report its location and strength.
